answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake before it may transact, like a pigment sample held in escrow: cheap to deposit once, ruinous to forfeit across a thousand sockpuppets. New identities enter through a narrow inlet, one verified onboarding per stake with rate limits, and build reputation only by completing real work in a shared lagoon of auditable transactions, so fakes cannot cheaply clone history. Misbehavior burns the stake, making mass fakery unprofitable.
